plugin.name: yandex
plugin.title: yandex
plugin.desc: A plugin to play Yandex Music on Lyrion Music Server (LMS).
plugin.changes: History and Audiobooks: Added a listening history section, progress auto-save, and a 1-click quick resume button to pick up right where you left off. Stable Resume and Seek: Improved seek stability and playback resumption for encrypted streams (AAC/FLAC), eliminating audio drops, freezes, and distortions. Vibe Wheel: Implemented dynamic redesign of the vibe wheel when changing moods or genres. Minor bug fixes.
plugin.creator: Alexander Chernysh
